title: Sentry Mode Idle Drain Cost
dataSources: Tesla vehicle and charge state (`tesla:vehicle`, `tesla:charge`), OBD-II PIDs (`obd:pid`), Smart EV charger sessions (`evcharger:session`).
app: Tesla Fleet API / TeslaMate, TeslaFi, and generic OBD-II / Smartcar / charger APIs via HEC scripted inputs and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=tesla:vehicle parked="true" sentry_mode="true"
| bin _time span=1d
| stats earliest(battery_kwh) as start_kwh, latest(battery_kwh) as end_kwh by vin _time
| eval kwh_used=round(start_kwh-end_kwh,2)
| where kwh_used>1
| sort - kwh_used
description: Measures the energy used while Sentry Mode is active so you can decide where the security trade-off is worth the battery trade-off.
value: A visible idle-cost number makes it easier to choose smarter parking behaviour than vague worries about range loss.
implementation: Forward parked battery-energy values alongside Sentry state; review daily and compare drain across common parking situations.
visualization: Daily bar chart of Sentry-related energy use.
grandmaExplanation: It compares how much battery your parked car is spending just to keep its sentry cameras and sensors awake.
